relationships.subject: ACC→contraCLA neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings suggest that CLA←contraACC neurons make excitatory glutamatergic synaptic contacts ipsilaterally with ACC neurons and preferentially activate fast-spiking INs (inhibitory INs) in the ACC.

relationships.subject: ACC→contraCLA neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Optogenetic stimulation of the terminals of ACC→contraCLA neurons in the right CLA induced a long lasting (100‒150 ms) silencing of spontaneous unit activity of pyramidal neurons in the right ACC

key_findings: ACC neurons project preferentially to contralateral claustrum, relaying via CLA to activate contralateral ACC fast-spiking interneurons.
Activating this circuit silences contralateral ACC pyramidal neurons and raises withdrawal thresholds.
